detailed_descriptions_html.en:
When Chests Rain Tons of Loot is an incremental loot game about building an army and grabbing tons of loot.

Drop your heroes anywhere on the field and they fight the slimes on your screen, while you grab the loot they drop. Everything you grab goes into your treasure chest.

The chest bursts

Fill your chest past its marks and it turns Silver, Gold or Diamond for even more gold. When time runs out, it bursts and rains everything back down for one last grab. LOOT IT!

Grow stronger

Spend your gold in a huge skill tree: more heroes, harder landings, more arrows, more gold and better loot. Every run is bigger than the last.

What's in the game

  • Your army: Archers, Thunder Mages and more. Drop them where you want and they fight on their own.

  • The Barbarian: he fires up your heroes with war cries.

  • A huge skill tree full of upgrades for your heroes and your loot.

  • Gear and the forge: equip items and refine them, but the higher you go, the bigger the risk.

  • Cards to collect and slot for big bonuses.

  • New lands and bosses: a new map every run, and a boss waiting in every land.

  • Surprises: Golden Slimes, Slime Rain, the Treasure Goblin.

  • An Adventure Book of every slime, boss and event you meet.

  • And TONS of loot!

Out now! Drop your heroes and let the loot rain begin!
